payload.title: Publish semantic roadmap and run an out-of-box Laya task-matching pilot
payload.description: Publish the saved retrieval/model roadmap to VXU Labs remote, create a distinct open-source alternatives evaluation backlog item, and run a reproducible no-fine-tuning local Laya pilot on fixed Hebrew/English task-pair labels. Retain errors and resource measurements, distinguish feasibility from domain readiness and whether training is warranted. Related research requirement: task_7d983f51fa4aa5ea423f209dd5f6142d8c577f80da9a7d4a42c86d1d044e2b40.
acceptance: Push saved roadmap and new alternatives backlog to https://github.com/vxu-labs/dip without publishing unrelated captured discussion/activity.
Preregister held-out task-pair inputs, labels and model runtime/revision before any Laya outcome; keep zero-shot pilot separate from any future fine-tuning.
Run the model locally in an isolated dependency/cache environment if supported; preserve complete outputs, failures, resource/latency measurements and setup limitations.
Publish a qualified conclusion about out-of-box task identity/overlap classification, without treating semantic scores as actual completion evidence.
